label: Ti:sapphire fs (Mai Tai HP)
tooltip: Spectra-Physics Mai Tai HP Ti:sapphire oscillator at its 800 nm tuning peak: 2.5 W average, <100 fs sech2 (modelled Gaussian), 80 MHz, 1.2 mm beam, linear polarization >500:1 (MKS/Spectra-Physics Mai Tai datasheet rev 6/26). Energy/pulse derives as power/rep_rate = 31 nJ.
